senses.definition: n. pr. m. founder of kingdom of Damascus, Solomon’s time, 1 K 11:23; 𝔊 (v 14) Εσρωμ [A v 23 Ραζων]; indentified with חֶזְיוֹן 15:18 by Th Klo (reading חזרון), but cf. Kit Benz.
